name: The Medicine Run
description: La Cocinera has synthesized a batch of antibiotics badly needed by a settlement in what used to be Guatemala. The road is controlled by a raider faction. She needs a courier who won't flinch.

stages.name: Pick Up the Medicine
stages.description: Collect La Cocinera's antibiotic batch from her Mexico City laboratory. She'll brief you on the road conditions and what to expect from the raider faction controlling the pass.

stages.name: Navigate the Raider Road
stages.description: The route through the old Mexico-Guatemala corridor is held by a raider faction called the Asphalt Saints. They tax all goods — or destroy them. Find a way through.

stages.name: Deliver the Antibiotics
stages.description: Reach the Guatemala settlement with the antibiotic batch intact. The settlement's medic is waiting at the eastern edge of the old market district, clear of the raider-held road.
